newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 7.35 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 7.35 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 9.5 trillion lire 26-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 7.35 percent, compared with 7.37 percent at the previous repo tender on February 24, the Bank said.
The average rate was 7.37 percent against 7.40 percent at the last repurchase pact for 5.5 trillion lire and 16 days.
The pact covers purchases today and the securities are for resale on March 24. The Bank said it received 48 bids of which 32 were met in full and nine in part.
